{{Youmay|the creature|the [[Eel (Strike-class)|strike cruiser]] or the [[Eel (pet)|pet]] owned by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]}}
{{Quote|Ah&hellip; eels. Very dangerous.|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]]|<ref name="Prisoners">{{TCW|Prisoners}}</ref>}}
'''Eels''' were long-bodied fish that were found all throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Known species==
[[File:RishiEel-TCW.png|thumb|right|250px|A Rishi eel.]]
*The [[Colo claw fish/Legends|Colo claw fish]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].
*[[Saberjowl/Legends|Saberjowl]], genetically altered clones of the colo claw fish, located on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].
*[[Sea eel]], also of Kamino.
*[[Rishi eel/Legends|Rishi eel]], a non-sea dwelling eel found on the [[Rishi moon]].
*[[Dashta eel]] of [[Ord Cestus/Legends|Ord Cestus]].
*The [[Armored eel/Legends|armored eel]] of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].
*[[Silman eel]], also of Yavin 4.
*[[Adegan eel]] of [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]].
*[[Camray eel]] of [[Spira/Legends|Spira]].
*[[Fleek eel/Legends|Fleek eel]] of [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]].
*[[Kreetch eel]] of Naboo.
*[[Ion eel]]s of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].
*[[Spice eel]] of [[Sevarcos II]].
*[[Stinger eel]] of [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]].
*[[Ralltiirieel]] of [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]].
*[[Mon Cala eel/Legends|Mon Cala eel]], found on [[Dac/Legends|Mon Cala]].
*[[Kaminoan electroeel]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].
*[[Tubular eel]] of [[Chad/Legends|Chad]].
*[[Brine-eel]].
*[[Blood eel]].
*[[Coufee]] eel, a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] bio-weapon.
*[[Plasma eel]], another Yuuzhan Vong bio-weapon.
*[[Telerath eel]], a large eel native to the planet [[Telerath/Legends|Telerath]].
*Various eels of the [[Valley of the Giant Oysters]] on Dac.
*[[Weed-eel]], a silver creature native to [[Qiilura/Legends|Qiilura]].
*[[Ophidions]] of [[Taypho]].<ref name="Cristaux">{{CasusBelliCite|76|La légende des cristaux}}</ref>

==Ambiguous eels and eel-like species==
*[[Keelkana/Legends|Keelkana]], also of Dac.
*[[Ground-eel]] of [[Qiilura/Legends|Qiilura]].
*[[Fanteel]], made into [[Fanteel steak]] on Kamino.
*[[Carnovian eel]]-pup, a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] delicacy.
*[[Stone eel]] of [[Storthus]].
*[[Devil serpent/Legends|Devil serpent]] of Endor.
*[[Anguilla]], a [[Sentience/Legends|Sentient]] species of [[Alluuvia]].
